subject: Evaluating Redwood — success criteria & MAP request
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@clearpathhealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@clearpathhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Apr 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evaluating Redwood — success criteria & MAP request

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We took it back to the engineering and clinical teams — there is strong interest, but before we kick off a formal POC leadership has asked for a short mutual action plan and a clear set of acceptance tests. They want to see the bar we need to hit to consider Redwood for production.

Top priorities for ClearPath:
- Latency: 95th percentile < 350ms for 1k-token prompts
- Throughput: sustain 200 reqs/min peak for batch inference during daily jobs
- Accuracy/concordance: >= 94% on our clinical extraction prompts (we can share a sample set)
- Security: SOC 2 + evidence of encrypted at rest and in-flight; ability to support customer-managed KMS
- Cost: run-rate estimate for our expected volume (monthly tokens)

Can you share a MAP template that includes exit gates (what would fail the POC), acceptance tests, owners, and a two-week close timeline for decision? I attached a sample scope sheet we use to outline what we’ll validate (evaluation_scope.xlsx).

We'd like to loop in engineering and procurement as soon as we have a proposed plan.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Patel
VP of Product
ClearPath Health

Attachment: evaluation_scope.xlsx (spreadsheet: test vectors, sample traffic profile)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@clearpathhealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, dylan_brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Apr 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluating Redwood — success criteria & MAP request

Samir — thanks for the clear ask and for sharing the scope. I sketched a compact MAP below that we can iterate on. High-level approach: 2-week POC with three validation tracks (performance, quality, security). Our goal is to give you deterministic pass/fail signals so leadership can make a go/no-go decision.

Mutual Action Plan (draft) — 2 week POC
Owners: Soojin (Redwood AE), Laura (Solutions Engineer), Dylan (Platform Eng)
Week 0 (Kickoff, day 0)
- Deliverables: test harness + sample prompts uploaded to a shared S3 (ClearPath provides samples)
- Redwood provides environment (hosted sandbox or dedicated eval node) and initial configuration (model variant, quantization profile)

Week 1 (Smoke & baseline)
- Performance smoke: measure p50/p95 latency on 50 synthetic streams and baseline throughput
- Quality smoke: run 200 hand-picked prompts from ClearPath set; measure concordance + precision/recall per-slot
- Security checklist: share SOC 2 scan pack; enable at-rest encryption and KMS demo

Week 2 (Stress & acceptance)
- Long-run stress: 4-hour sustained throughput test at target profile (200 reqs/min)
- Acceptance suite: 1,000 sample vectors with scoring rules; concordance >= 94% required for pass
- Failure modes: define roll-forward/rollback (see exit gates)

Acceptance tests (explicit)
- Perf: p95 latency <= 350ms on production-like tokens; <1% request failures
- Throughput: sustained window >= 95% of target for 4-hour run
- Quality: Weighted F1 >= 0.90 across critical entities OR concordance >= 94% across full sample set
- Stability: no unrecoverable OOMs or cache-miss regressions during 4h stress
- Security: evidence of SOC 2 or in-flight proof-of-compliance; KMS integration demo complete

Exit gates (fail conditions)
- Immediate fail: data exfiltration finding or >5% high-severity errors during the stress test
- Conditional fail: p95 latency > 500ms or concordance < 88% — engineering triage + 3 business days to remediate; if unresolved, POC fails

Operational notes
- Test harness: Laura will provide a simple runner that emits load and collects metrics to a shared dashboard (Prometheus/Grafana).
- Cost estimate: we'll provide a token-based run-rate after the first week once we know batching/KV cache behavior on your vectors.

Next steps
1) Agree on the sample vectors (you shared the scope attachment — can you drop the test set to the S3 link below?)
2) Confirm whether you want hosted sandbox vs dedicated eval node (dedicated gives more representative perf)
3) Sign off on quick MAP and confirm kickoff date (we can start as early as next Monday)

Onboarding links
- S3 dropbox: https://redwood-internal.sharepoint.com/sites/evals/clearpath
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/CPH-2025-0422

I'll prepare a one-page MAP PDF (MAP_v1.0.pdf) once we agree on these points.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: MAP_skeleton.xlsx (internal)

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@clearpathhealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@clearpathhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Apr 2025 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluating Redwood — success criteria & MAP request

Thanks Soojin — this looks good and thorough. A few clarifications from our side:
- The clinical team will measure concordance but will also require per-field precision thresholds for three critical slots (diagnosis_code, medication_name, dosage). Can you make those explicit in the acceptance suite?
- Procurement wants an estimated cost top-line for a 3-month pilot (we expect ~15M tokens/month). Please include both hosted and dedicated pricing bands.
- On security: we need proof of KMS key rotation and an auditor contact for SOC 2 artifacts — can your security team provide a short Q&A?

I attached a short doc with the POC requirements (POC_requirements.docx). We'd like the finalized MAP and timeline by end of day tomorrow so we can schedule the kickoff for Monday.

Samir

Attachment: POC_requirements.docx

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@clearpathhealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, dylan_brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 23 Apr 2025 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluating Redwood — success criteria & MAP request

Samir — great notes. Quick confirmation and finalization below; I’ve also attached a one-page MAP PDF (MAP_v1.0.pdf) to make signoff easier.

Acceptance test additions (per your request)
- Per-field precision thresholds (minimums to pass):
  * diagnosis_code: precision >= 0.92
  * medication_name: precision >= 0.90
  * dosage: precision >= 0.88
- Pilot cost estimate (3 months, 15M tokens/month):
  * Hosted sandbox: ~$9,000/month (est.) — includes shared capacity, good for exploration but may show higher p95
  * Dedicated eval node: ~$25,000/month (est.) — committed capacity, representative perf; includes higher telemetry retention
  (Final numbers subject to batching behavior; we’ll deliver a refined run-rate after week 1)
- Security Q&A: Dylan will be the primary contact and will provide a 1-pager on KMS rotation and SOC 2 artifacts by EOD.

Final MAP timeline (kickoff Monday, Apr 28)
- Day 0 (Mon Apr 28): Kickoff + test set drop
- Day 1–3: Baseline smoke and configuration changes
- Day 4–7: Quality evaluation and per-field scoring
- Day 8–11: Stress + throughput verification
- Day 12–14: Final acceptance sweep + decision meeting (Leadership review)

Signoff steps
- ClearPath product lead (Samir) signs MAP_v1.0.pdf and confirms test-set delivery
- Redwood signs internal execution checklist and assigns instrumentation owners (Laura)

If that all looks good I’ll upload MAP_v1.0.pdf to the HubSpot deal and we can route a DocuSign.

Thanks — looking forward to kicking this off.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
